decision.text: TaskState.mjs kept as the old wrapper class (its test uses the class API); Servex TaskLoop now spawns AIIndex.mjs --watch directly; State.mjs and doc/state.md are stubs until 2026-10-27. Class names DashState and TaskStateLog left unrenamed (alternative: rename them too).

log.msg: Landed on worktree/ai-index-rename (3 commits). AIIndex, TaskState and Day tests pass; AIIndex.mjs writes ai/index.json and one ai/index.jsonl line, check.ok true. merge --dry-run refused: needs review.mjs first (parent's call). /framework/ai/ loads at 1200 on the worktree proxy. core/Task Task.js comments still cite Server/doc/state.md (off-limits; the stub keeps the link alive). After merge restart Servex so TaskLoop spawns AIIndex.mjs; then the old state.json and state.jsonl go stale and can be removed.
